replies.author: Awarrior
replies.body:
Small Specifications:

General:
- Green = Spartans (From the Halo franchise)
- Red = Elites    (From the Halo franchise)
- Players will have speed I.

Armor:
- Only leather hats colored either red or green.
- Iron Sword Sharness I
- Bow Power II Infinity I
- Normal Diamond Pickaxe

Gameplay:
- No logs given.
-  8 Enchant bottles.
- 64 of either green or red clay.
- Possibility to craft Gold armor.
- 4 monuments on each sides placed strategically. 

Map Making Tools used:
- World Painter
- World Edit
- Voxel Sniper
- My hands
- Took 8 hours to make

replies.body:
Okay I'm expressing my own opinion here, sorry if it offends anyone.
Since we have multiple threads complaining about the quality of maps blah blah blah...
I'm going to say this will be another one of those being complained about, these mountains give limited space for pvp, this will also then give the players advantages by taking on the higher ground. It will be annoying to kill players on, whether its DTM or Nexus (Which one is it? Fix it up :P)
They can also be used as a route destroy the monument by scaling around map making it easier to break.
From the image it looks like ice has been used for the river, this is another aspect for annoying game play.  
Besides those points it looks great
Maybe I should download it and try it out, but with experience and knowing how hard it is with bad ping, I personally think the map game play wont turn out well.

replies.body: I feel like this is an underrated map. You all are disliking it due to how it will play, due to it's ice pvp, or other aspects. But isn't that what makes it unique? It's a challenge, it's really great looking and it's always worth it to try it out. With it's size, hilliness, and other features, it differs it from other maps and makes it fun to play on. The challenge also is what Awarrior was heading for. I don't want him to feel bad, I really do like this map and while feedback is feedback, I think he gets the point :(
